title: Oil Free American Oats Pancakes
description: A light and springy American dish featuring rolled oats, these pancakes are a delicious and healthy breakfast option. They are made with katsuramuki-cut rolled oats and are raw-friendly.
instructions: Combine the rolled oats, almond milk, apple cider vinegar, baking powder, and salt in a blender and blend until smooth.
Add the vanilla extract and maple syrup to the blender and blend until well combined.
Add the mashed banana to the blender and blend until the batter is smooth and creamy.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot and enjoy.
